Overview

The hidden cost of Applied AI & GenAI for Banking & Financial Services is never the model; it is the scaffolding — data contracts, evaluation harnesses, rollback machinery, audit evidence. We price and build that scaffolding explicitly, on core banking rails, because that is where programs actually succeed or die. The Banking & Financial Services operating reality gives this work its shape: instant rails pressure at event speed, DORA operational resilience obligations on every artifact, and practitioners who will not accept recommendations they cannot interrogate. The pattern below is calibrated to those three forces.
